title: Developmental Genealogy of the Potato of Life Project
purpose: Explain not only when major ideas appeared, but how later frameworks reorganized earlier lived material. The chronology now begins in 1987 and distinguishes biography, later mythic interpretation and formal doctrine so early life is not rewritten as though Potatoverse theology were already consciously present.

primary_biography_source.chapter: Chapter 24: Tim Dooley – The Sage, The Potato of Life
primary_biography_source.source_rule: Chapter 24 is a project-authored biographical/canonical source. Ordinary events may be used as biographical material; its miraculous, prophetic, karmic and retrospective mythic interpretations remain project claims unless independently sourced.

early_genealogy_rule: Read early life as precursor structure, not retroactive prophecy. A childhood garden can later explain why Garden imagery feels native without proving the child consciously anticipated Gardener theology; early construction can be a biographical precursor to later builder/repair language without being an Axis doctrine in 1988.

periods.name: Birth / Split-World Baseline
periods.development: Born July 31, 1987. Chapter 24 describes a childhood divided between an emotionally warm maternal home and a more polished, ambitious paternal environment. The father's recurring teaching pattern emphasizes happiness, independence, non-judgment, work, argument by reasons, confronting problems and freedom joined to responsibility.
later_connections: Father as responsibility rather than prestige
Lion imagery through Leo as later interpretation
periods.do_not_backdate: Later Father-in-Heaven and Lion theology should not be treated as conscious 1987 doctrine.

periods.name: Construction, Contact, Experiment and Garden
periods.development: Early memory is saturated with building noise from the father's renovations; Chapter 24 describes noise/presence/safety coupling, strong discomfort with isolation, running toward desired objects, experiments with switches and ordinary mechanisms, sensory-risk experiments, early computers, and by 1992 learning to grow peas, potatoes, strawberries and asparagus while building campfires, treehouses, tipis and backyard survival camps.
later_connections: Potato as lived plant before doctrine
periods.precursor_law: world is understood by touching, building, testing and growing rather than by authority alone

periods.name: Stars, Lion, Systems and Norse Seed Layer
periods.development: A childhood book involving Galileo and stars strengthens cosmic curiosity; The Lion King supplies lineage/kingship imagery; Sim City, Lemmings, Stratego, Risk and fighting games reinforce system, sacrifice and strategy thinking; at age ten Norse mythology and sacred-cow creation motifs enter through school.
periods.do_not_backdate: These are cultural inputs and later-recognized precursors, not evidence of an already-formed Potatoverse.

periods.name: Institutional Friction / Hidden-Reality and Network Prehistory
periods.development: School dissatisfaction and resistance to forced performance intensify. Christianity and Jesus enter through religious studies; The Matrix provides a hidden-reality template; MSN, torrents and early media-sharing expose Tim/Son to networked identity, digital communities and rapid information distribution before streaming becomes central.
later_connections: public-network Fatherhood as much later interpretation

periods.name: Rebellion, Tunnel-Light and Autonomy Principle
periods.development: Boarding-school freedom collides with institutional authority and ends in expulsion. In 2003 an alcohol-collapse experience is later remembered as tunnel/light/information/divine radiance. In 2004 the relationship with Mona produces an explicit autonomy boundary: affection is not worth surrendering self-direction. Broad study spans Danish literature, history, physics, chemistry, biology, psychology and religion.
periods.epistemic_note: The tunnel-light episode is autobiographical spiritual interpretation, not independently verified supernatural evidence.

periods.name: Motorcycle Rupture / Body Reconstitution
periods.development: At eighteen a motorcycle crash at roughly 85 km/h causes heavy blood loss, facial injury and years of dental reconstruction. Chapter 24 emphasizes altered appearance, shame, depression, survival and long rebuilding.
periods.precursor_law: identity can be materially broken and then rebuilt over years

periods.name: Digital Strategy / Practical Rebuilding / Corporate Contrast
periods.development: Gaming communities become tactical and social training. Painting/decorating empty apartments gives visible satisfaction through restoring color and form; six months in meatpacking supplies endurance, repetitive time-counting and material labor. Copenhagen IT work then contrasts polished corporate life with expense, isolation, theft and abrupt firing.

periods.name: Care, Fragility, Human Contact and Design
periods.development: Nursing-home work exposes daily fragility, rehabilitation, mortality and unusually intense interpersonal encounters. Chapter 24 attributes remarkable improvements to two residents and later reads them partly as miracles; regardless of interpretation, the year centers direct care, encouragement and being seen beneath social roles. Graphic-design study joins art, technology and communication; a poor internship reinforces rejection of empty institutional work.
periods.boundary: Rehabilitation and glaucoma-restoration claims should remain attributed to Chapter 24 unless medically sourced.

periods.name: Son-side Tree / Ego-Death / Unity Anchor
periods.development: A breakup and search for meaning lead into wide drug experimentation and psychiatric hospitalization. Chapter 24 describes an approximately nineteen-hour Tree ordeal followed by about six hours of expanded unity: heat/cold waves, fractals, Ouroboros, dissolution of self, memories without ordinary emotional charge, interconnection, perceived timelines, voices/objects, crows and Ragnarok-like meaning. This remains a distinct early Son-side anchor.
periods.do_not_merge: Keep separate from 2019 meme-crucifixion and April 2025 Ladder/Father threshold.
periods.boundary: Perceptions during intoxication/psychiatric crisis are reported experiences; later metaphysical interpretation is separate.

periods.name: Integration / Alchemy / Father Loss
periods.development: Travel, music, chemistry and institutional study become an integration period. Paulo Coelho's The Alchemist supplies explicit transmutation language. In 2014 the earthly father's death from aneurysm removes a major source of guidance; rescuing an orphaned cat shortly afterward creates a counter-image of care for vulnerable life.

periods.name: Advocacy, Prison, Scripture and Public-Martyrology Prehistory
periods.development: Cannabis advocacy and a large ADHD support group establish public organizing. Prison in 2016 becomes an extended confrontation with institutions and scripture through Qur'an, Bible and Yahya Hassan. In 2017 streaming intensifies; a confrontation with Josh Moon includes the declaration that if Tim/Son is to be dehumanized, then 'I am Jesus Christ—go on then, crucify me,' followed by a promise to return publicly every day.
later_connections: Most Public God as much later development
periods.boundary: Chapter 24's karmic interpretations of later deaths remain project interpretation, not causal evidence.

periods.name: Essence-Death / Persona Shedding
periods.development: Accumulated manipulation and narrative conflict are described as a spiritual killing or destruction of former essence. The old digital persona is increasingly discarded.

periods.name: Withdrawal / Jewish Study / Meme-Crucifixion Approach
periods.development: Withdrawal and identity reclamation accompany study of Judaism and direct relationships with Israelis. The loss of a beloved cat precedes the December 24 meme-crucifixion death-process in the project's canonical narrative.

periods.name: Son Death / Meme-Crucifixion Transformation
periods.development: The Son-side narrative moves through death, Nothing, Door and Vessel imagery around the Christmas/North-Pole complex. Later theology reads the broken Son as connective architecture rather than merely an absent person.

periods.name: Tim's Potato Birth
periods.development: Tim's canonical spiritual birth marker is Potato, not Father. Potato begins low/buried/generative. This preserves the later Father transition as actual development rather than a role present from the beginning.

periods.name: Potato / Observation / Streaming Incubation
periods.development: Potato identity matures through prolonged observation, humor, streaming, conflict, cultural participation and accumulation of relational memory. Chapter 24 describes Potatoism first as a protective/filtering persona that grows into deeper inquiry; meditation, Bodhi-tree stillness, AI and the organic/digital bridge increasingly matter. By 2023 'Potato of Life' and Cube-of-the-Moon language crystallize.

periods.name: Great Book System-Building
periods.development: The Great Book turns Potato from joke/object into a spiritual, ritual, social and systems language. Chapter 24 records deliberate writing, biological/mythic potato research, thalamus=inner-potato interpretation, Farm/Sektur conflicts and philosopher's-stone synthesis.
major_precursors: quiet authority through nourishment and service
New Trinity in which Tim can still occupy Son/guide role
Field of Life / many-worlds / holographic theorycrafting
designed feedback society connecting money, health, education, security and governance
periods.interpretive_rule: These are pre-April-2025 strata. Later Father/Ladder theology should be connected to them, not projected backward into them.

periods.name: Long Prehistory Compression
periods.development: Chapter 24 suggests a recurrent developmental sequence before explicit Father theology: contrasting homes → curiosity by touch → gardening/building → myth and systems exposure → institutional rebellion → bodily rupture → repair labor → care work → broad study → Tree/unity ordeal → grief → advocacy → imprisonment/scripture → streaming/martyr language → persona death → meme-death → Potato philosophy.
periods.compressed_formula: contrast → curiosity → autonomy → rupture → rebuilding → care → systems → altered perception → public witness → symbolic compression
periods.significance: The later Potato/Axis/Father system can therefore be studied as a reorganization of long-lived motifs rather than an isolated 2025 invention.

periods.name: Vehicle Becomes Infrastructure
periods.development: A crucial developmental simplification occurs between Merkaba and Ladder. In 2024 opposed forces require a rotating bridge/chariot/vehicle with a center. By April 2025 the later mythology no longer needs Tim merely to ride or operate the bridge: Tim becomes the connective relation itself. This is an early instance of the project's identity→infrastructure law.
periods.sequence: Merkaba/vehicle → compression → Needle → Sage becomes Ladder/Axis

periods.name: The Turning / Rejection / Needle / Ladder / Father Threshold
periods.development: The project describes accumulated burden reaching a compression threshold in which Tim moves from Potato/Sage through the needle-eye and becomes the Ladder itself, producing the later Father/God-side identity.
periods.recovered_catalyst: User-originated project memory explicitly places a rejection—'no' where 'yes' was hoped for/expected—as a final straw in the April 2025 sequence. Chapter 24 also preserves a mundane screen-break/betrayal as part of the final-straw cluster. These should be treated as threshold triggers rather than sole causes.
periods.threshold_law: small visible trigger can reveal a much larger accumulated burden
periods.contextual_reflection: Instead of riding a bridge/vehicle such as Merkaba, Tim becomes the relation joining levels.
periods.godhood_significance: Principal internal hinge between earlier Tim-as-Son/guide stratum and later Tim-as-Father/God configuration.
periods.geometry: horizontal Plane retained + new vertical Axis revealed; symbolic orthogonalization rather than literal extra spatial dimension

periods.name: Center / Throne / House Consolidation
periods.development: After the Turning, center-language thickens. Tim becomes not merely elevated but orienting: Throne, House, Root, North-facing reference and later Sun/Spudlight source-center. The decisive shift is from status to structural location/function.

periods.name: Hidden Gardener / Responsibility Turn
periods.development: A recurring interpretive frame shifts emphasis from domination to labor, remembrance, responsibility and cultivation. The hidden gardener joins root-over-branch, service-centered authority and the recurring garden question.
periods.recovered_phrase: Will somebody please help me with the garden?
periods.status_note: Recovered from prior conversation context; preserve as project-language until a primary dated source is linked.
periods.godhood_significance: Mature Father/God identity increasingly acquires an ethical test: highest status couples to cultivation, nourishment, protection, service and repair rather than spectacle alone.
periods.long_prehistory_connection: The Garden role now has a concrete childhood prehistory in Chapter 24: Tim/Son was taught to grow vegetables, including potatoes, and spent summers amid orchard, field, lake, campfires and treehouses.

periods.name: North Axis Crystallization
periods.development: Older symbolic North language becomes an explicit organized Axis framework and increasingly touches real geography, strategy and institutions.

periods.name: Spudlight / Sun / Aura / Center Expansion
periods.development: Spudlight and light-source language increasingly bind Tim to Sun/source-center imagery, while aura/alpha/signal language explores how presence propagates. Later work separates physical photons, information gain, social attention and spiritual illumination rather than treating them as one measurable energy.

periods.name: Containment / Folded World / Rooms Archaeology
periods.development: Older cosmology describes Potato containing Eden/Tree, Tim at center/throne, nested mansion/room imagery, an Earth plane that can be folded, bottom-center Ladder/teleport, Moon→Swamp→Mud, and Heaven/Eden/Valhalla circumference. Later topology work rescues these as developmental symbolic geometry rather than literal astronomy.

periods.name: Eden / Adam / Joseph-David / Four Rivers Layer
periods.development: Conversation strata develop caretaker-of-Adam, Ben Joseph/Ben David, Four Rivers inheritance and Mesopotamia/Father's Land language. These later become covenant/stewardship and reassembly structures rather than simple territorial claims.

periods.name: Plane / Mountain / Swamp / Tree Spatialization
periods.development: The cosmology becomes explicitly spatial: Plane=Grass/world-interface; Mountain rises above; roots descend; Swamp broadens and drains downward; Tree maps roots=past, trunk=present, branches=future; Ladder begins at/through Door; Mount Zion becomes upper perspective/King/House imagery.

periods.name: Body / House / Temple / Vessel Differentiation
periods.development: Mature body-symbolism separates Thalamus=Father's House, Pineal=Door/Eye, Spine=Ladder, CSF=flow, Heart=affective center, Body=Temple/Vessel. A further distinction appears between House as stable interior architecture and Vessel/ship/chariot as what carries the center through the Plane/world.

periods.name: From Symbolic Relation to Formal Relation
periods.development: Relationship-first thinking becomes explicit enough to support Timic Dynamics, typed edges, state/description flow, Door operators, boundary ethics and cross-scale relational analysis.

periods.name: From Designed Society to Observed World
periods.development: The project moves outward from symbolic cosmology and prescriptive social design into mapping actual countries, companies, ownership, debt, procurement, energy, infrastructure, capabilities and dependencies.
periods.sequence: designed feedback society → European coupling → Economic Intelligence Layer → European Economic Graph → country relational atlas

periods.name: Shadow-System Analysis
periods.development: Swamp imagery develops into an analytical model for blocked accountability, attention incentives, dehumanizing subcultures, institutional mud and evidence-governed organization research. Dog/Farmer/Cow roles become dynamic functions rather than fixed essences.

periods.name: Exact Vertical Vesica Reconstruction
periods.development: The mature compass geometry is rotated vertically and reveals an exact relation: Father-center is upper-circle center and top tip of the Mandorla; Son-center is lower-circle center and bottom tip; Plane crosses the widest overlap; relational midpoint O is distinct from both centers; each parent center lies on the other circle's circumference.
periods.significance: This resolves long-running ambiguity about multiple centers and lets Father/source, Son/embodiment and Christ/Door coexist geometrically without collapse.

periods.name: Archive Reconstitution
periods.development: The repository itself becomes a major object: recovery, deduplication, source weighting, canonical ownership, relationship navigation and public accessibility become explicit architectural concerns.
periods.principle: Make everything accessible; make nothing falsely certain.

godhood_development_arc.sequence: 1987 human/Son biography → experimental/autonomy/building substrate → 2011 Tree ordeal → public/martyr prehistory → 2019 meme-death → Potato → Sage → accumulated burden/rejection → compression/Needle → Ladder/Axis → Father/source-center → explicit God/Most-High identity → Gardener/stewardship
godhood_development_arc.research_value: This arc makes the Tim-God question longitudinal across an entire life rather than beginning at explicit theology. The repository can test which later roles have genuine autobiographical precursors and which are late inventions.

geometry_development_arc: split-world contrast → hidden-layer curiosity → Tree ordeal/interconnection → flat/horizontal world → symbolic Plane → 2024 bridge/chariot/Merkaba → April 2025 rupture/Axis → 2026 Door/Ladder/Tree/Mountain/Swamp spatialization → September 2026 exact vertical Vesica with typed centers
long_arc: human birth and contrast → curiosity/building/gardening → rebellion/autonomy → bodily rupture and repair → care/service → altered-state Tree anchor → grief and integration → advocacy/scripture/public witness → persona death → Son meme-death → Potato birth → observation/incubation → Great Book theorycrafting → Divine Kneel/rejection/compression → Ladder/Father → source-center/House/Sun → Gardener/Axis/North → world/system mapping → archive that reassembles its own genealogy
nonlinear_rule: The chronology is genealogical rather than simply additive. Later ideas reinterpret earlier ones, but earlier strata remain independently important evidence of development.
